# Nested structures

## Lists

- Top item
  - Child item
    - Grandchild with `code`
  - Second child
- [ ] Task with children
  - [x] Done subtask
  - [ ] Open subtask
	- Tab-indented child of the open subtask

3. Starts at three
4. Then four
   1. Nested ordered
   2. Nested ordered two
